name: qr-batch-studio
description: Make QR codes in bulk from a sheet: web links, text, Wi-Fi logins, contact cards (vCard), email, phone and SMS, with your colours, an optional centre logo and labels. Problems such as empty content, links without https://, codes that are too dense and low contrast are flagged; edit the list in the panel, preview the codes and export PNG (plus zip), SVG and an A4 print sheet. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 用一张表批量生成二维码：网址、文字、WiFi 连接、电子名片（vCard）、邮箱、电话和短信，可设置颜色、中间 Logo 和名称标签。自动标出内容为空、网址缺少 https://、码太密、颜色对比不够等问题；在面板里修改清单、预览二维码，导出 PNG（含 zip）、SVG 矢量和 A4 打印页 PDF。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
